assets.name: Verdant
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production diffuse/albedo texture for a fictional planet in a realistic 3D space game.
Create a brand new 2048 by 1024 pixel, exactly 2:1, flat rectangular equirectangular FULL-SPHERE surface map of VERDANT, an entirely invented temperate world. The image is the texture itself, filling all pixels edge to edge, NOT a picture of a globe, map sheet, or satellite hovering above a globe.
Geography: three or four highly irregular branching green and copper continents, separated by expansive deep navy oceans, with unusual narrow inland seas and serrated peninsulas. Design original shapes that cannot be mistaken for any Earth continent or known real planet. Avoid the familiar Earth global distribution. Show sharply detailed dendritic river watersheds, folded gray-brown mountain ranges, finely eroded dry copper uplands, fertile forest regions, intricate sharp coastal fjords and estuaries. Narrow cyan continental shelves follow the coast only; deep ocean stays dark blue. Invent every coastline and landmass.
Rendering: near-photographic satellite terrain detail, physically plausible dense geology and natural subdued colors, crisp fine spatial detail that holds up when zoomed. This is unlit base color, without cast shadows or directional highlights. Equally exposed everywhere.
Projection: seamless longitude wrapping, matching left and right edges over uninterrupted deep ocean. True equirectangular polar stretching at top and bottom, smoothly converging muted gray ice at both poles. Every pixel opaque. No black/empty background, globe curvature, planet rim, perspective, clouds, atmosphere, haze, sun, terminator, vignette, labels, borders, grids or text.
Avoid: recognizable Earth geography, copied real-world coastlines, simple fractal noise, soft blurry terrain, repeating jigsaw fissures, cartoon colors, outlined regions, flat posterized patches.

assets.name: Ares
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: High-resolution production albedo texture for a realistic fictional planetary surface.
Generate at 3072 x 1536 pixels if possible, at least 2048 x 1024, exactly a 2:1 aspect ratio. The image must be a FLAT EQUIRECTANGULAR FULL-SPHERE diffuse surface texture, edge to edge, opaque, not a rendered globe.
Subject: ARES, a completely invented dry ochre world. Invent the planet from scratch: intricate winding interconnected pale canyon networks through weathered rust and ochre plateaus, fine dendritic erosion tributaries, broad dusty tan sedimentary basins, layered eroded mesas, irregular dark volcanic uplands, subtle ancient small impact scars. Vary the terrain density naturally around the sphere. Include a few long sinuous dry channels with beautiful sharply textured walls, but no one famous straight giant canyon. The geography and geology must not reproduce Mars, Earth, or another real Solar System body. No recognizable Valles Marineris, Olympus Mons, Martian cap shape, real crater layout, continent layout, or terrestrial canyon.
Style: crisp almost-photographic satellite composite detail at several scales, with finely resolved rock and sediment texture rather than generic fractal noise. Restrained dusty ochre, burnt sienna, warm mineral gray, pale tawny strata. Rich subtle albedo variation. Sharp complex geological edges and smooth natural dust plains coexist. No repeating jigsaw pattern and no artificial outlining.
Projection and illumination: actual full sphere equirectangular layout from north pole top to south pole bottom, longitude wraps continuously across the left/right edges. Stretch near-pole features horizontally to converge naturally on the sphere. Entire surface is equally exposed unlit base color, not baked directional shadows. Uniform opacity.
No clouds, atmosphere, haze, illumination gradient, terminator, black space, border, sphere curvature, perspective, labels, text, map grid, water, cities, roads, or vegetation. Entire canvas is planetary ground material.

assets.name: Pelagia
assets.prompt:

Asset type: 3D space game planet albedo texture.
Create one original full spherical surface map for PELAGIA, an invented deep ocean planet. Flat rectangular EQUIRECTANGULAR texture exactly 2:1, preferably 3072x1536 pixels, at least 2048x1024, all pixels filled with opaque surface texture. Do NOT render a globe.
Design: approximately 90% navy and deep teal ocean with only a few invented narrow curving island arcs, jagged small green volcanic islands and scattered irregular pale turquoise atolls. All geography newly invented; no Earth continent outlines, Hawaii, Indonesia, Japan, Caribbean, Polynesia, recognizable archipelago or real planet layout. Island clusters should be elegant and restrained, spanning several separated regions with enormous uninterrupted deep seas between them. No broad continents. Detailed narrow cyan shelves, underwater ridges visible only through clear shallow water, tiny reef passages and estuaries around land. Islands have fine crisp dark mineral rock, folded eroded peaks and subdued vegetation, pale beaches only very thin at shore. Deep ocean is rich subdued dark navy, with subtle diffuse natural water color variation, no giant ocean waves or sparkling highlights.
Style: near-photographic satellite base-color composite. Beautiful sharply resolved irregular shorelines and reefs with believable intricate multiscale details. Natural materials, no neon, no outlines, no painterly or soft fractal noise, no repeating cellular/jigsaw crack patterns.
Projection requirements: truly full-sphere equirectangular layout north-to-south; left/right edges match as uninterrupted dark navy ocean for seamless longitude wrap. Near poles become quieter uniformly deep ocean with subtle pale blue sea ice close to the very top and bottom, naturally stretched by latitude. No clouds or haze. No directional lighting, cast shadows, terminator, atmosphere, black space, globe shape, curvature, perspective, borders, labels, typography, watermark or grid. It is the usable unlit planet diffuse map itself.

assets.name: Weather
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production cloud-opacity texture for a fictional 3D planet atmosphere layer.
Create a FLAT FULL-SPHERE EQUIRECTANGULAR grayscale cloud-opacity map, exact 2:1 aspect ratio, preferably 2048x1024 or larger. The full rectangular image is the usable opacity texture itself. Pure black means clear sky. White or gray means cloud opacity. This is a newly invented weather system from scratch; do not copy NASA or any real Earth weather map.
Composition: over 65 percent of the entire canvas must remain pure black clear sky. Distribute two asymmetrical SMALL spiral cyclones at irregular offset positions, each under one eighth of the canvas width, one diffuse and the other more organized. Add a few separated long meandering oblique weather fronts with sharply detailed thin cirrus filaments and finely mottled natural isolated cloud banks. Their orientations vary widely. Irregular feathered edges, delicate small wisps and textured white cores; multiscale photographic cloud detail without blurry generic noise. Large clear black regions separate the weather systems.
Projection: longitude wraps seamlessly across matching CLEAR BLACK left and right edges. Sparse polar clouds that stop before the borders; top and bottom pole rows entirely black, with small near-polar features naturally stretched horizontally for equirectangular projection. Black background fills all clear gaps.
Entire image is strictly grayscale, opaque raster pixels, unlit texture, no colored pixels and no alpha transparency. No planet, globe, continents, terrain, oceans, geographic hints, horizon, space, stars, illumination, gradients across the whole image, terminator, cast shadows, rim, text, labels, border, grid, or watermark. Do not make uniformly horizontal repetitive stripes, bands, a worldwide continuous cloud blanket, paint strokes, or soft low-detail haze. Only finely detailed invented weather coverage on clean black.
